scenes.vo: Here's how you could run a roofing office with twelve AI agents and no office staff.
In the middle sits one AI office manager. Every call, text and email goes through it.
Miss a call? Agent one texts them back. Agent two catches every website form.
Three drafts the quote with your prices. Four follows up on day three and day seven.
Five books the inspection on your calendar. Six sends a reminder the night before.
Seven sends the on my way text. Eight files the crew's job photos.
Nine sends the invoice, and ten nudges anyone who hasn't paid.
Eleven asks for the review. Twelve sends you a report every Monday.
The whole thing runs for about twenty five dollars a month.
